title: CCSDS RS Decoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/CCSDS_RS_Decoder.md
text: Decode and recover message from RS codeword according to CCSDS standard, 2 inputs, 5 outputs; {Message length (k)} sets the length of message, {Interleaving depth (I)} sets the depth of interleaving and {Output number of corrected symbol errors} sets the number of corrected symbol errors. Values come from the instance.
